## NINEONELABS Renewal Project - Careers & Award Pages Structure

Based on my exploration of the codebase, here's the current structure for responsive design planning:

---

### **1. PHP Views (Located in `views/pages/`)**

**Careers Index Page**
- **File:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\views\pages\careers\index.php`
- **Layout Type:** Vertical list with filter bar
- **Key Class Names:**
  - `.no-sub-careers` — main section wrapper
  - `.no-sub-list` — unordered list container (flexbox column)
  - `.no-sub-list-item` — individual list items
  - `.no-sub-list-item__link` — clickable item wrapper
  - `.no-sub-list-item__body` — item content area
  - `.no-filter-bar` — filter control bar (position: relative, sticky)
  - `.no-filter-bar__group` — filter dropdowns container
  - `.no-filter-bar__search` — search input area
  - `.no-meta-list` — tags/metadata container
  - `.no-container-2xl` — max-width content wrapper
- **Structure:** Filter bar → list items → view more button

**Careers View (Detail) Page**
- **File:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\views\pages\careers\view.php`
- **Layout Type:** Two-column grid (content + sidebar info)
- **Key Class Names:**
  - `.no-sub-careers-view` — main section wrapper
  - `.no-sub-careers-view__inner` — grid container (8fr/4fr on desktop)
  - `.no-sub-careers-view__wrap` — article/content column
  - `.no-sub-careers-view__info` — sidebar info panel (flex column)
  - `.no-sub-careers-view__info-card` — info card wrapper
  - `.no-sub-careers-view__info-item` — individual info rows
  - `.no-sub-careers-view__map` — embedded iframe container
  - `.no-container-xl` — max-width wrapper
- **Structure:** Article content on left, info sidebar on right (map + details + apply button)

**Award Page**
- **File:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\views\pages\inside\award.php`
- **Layout Type:** Table-like grid list with hover preview
- **Key Class Names:**
  - `.no-sub-award` — main section wrapper
  - `.no-sub-award__head` — column header row (grid: 1fr 6fr 1fr 4fr)
  - `.no-sub-award-list` — unordered list container
  - `.no-sub-award-item` — individual award row
  - `.no-sub-award-item__link` — clickable award wrapper (grid layout)
  - `.no-sub-award-item__year` — year column
  - `.no-sub-award-item__project` — project name column
  - `.no-sub-award-item__award` — award logo/icon column
  - `.no-sub-award-item__prize` — prize description column
  - `.no-award-hover-preview` — floating preview image (position: fixed)
  - `.no-sub-award-item--empty` — empty state variant
- **Interactive:** Hover preview panel appears on item hover

---

### **2. SCSS Responsive Patterns (Located in `resource/scss/pages/`)**

**File:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource\scss\pages\_sub.scss`

**Careers List Page Responsive Behavior:**
- Uses flexbox column layout (always vertical)
- Filter bar uses `@include mq(lg)` → switches from row to column layout, dropdowns become full-width
- List items use `@include mq(md)` → hides button wrap, removes horizontal padding on links
- Border patterns: 2px top border on list, 1px bottom borders on items
- Hover states with background color transitions

**Careers View Page Responsive Behavior:**
- Grid layout: `grid-template-columns: 8fr 4fr` (desktop)
- `@include mq(md)` breakpoint → `grid-template-columns: 1fr` (sidebar stacks below content)
- Gap: `var(--gutter-md)`
- Fluid typography: `fluid(64, 128)` for padding-top
- Map maintains aspect-ratio: 16/9

**Award Page Responsive Behavior:**
- Header & items use 4-column grid: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 6fr 1fr 4fr`
- **IMPORTANT:** No media queries defined in current SCSS — grid layout stays fixed across all breakpoints
- Award icons use `fluid(32, 48)` for responsive sizing
- Hover preview uses `width: fluid(220, 320)` (responsive fixed positioning)
- List items use `grid-column: 1 / -1` for empty state spanning full width

**Filter Bar (Component) Responsive:**
- `@include mq(lg)` → changes from `flex-direction: row` to `flex-direction: column`
- Dropdowns get `width: 100%` on smaller screens
- Search area becomes full-width

---

### **3. TypeScript Runtime Configuration**

**File:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\resource/ts/config/component.config.ts`

**Career & Award Interactions:**
- `.no-sub-list-item__link` — magnetic corner button behavior on careers list items
- `.no-sub-award-item__link` — magnetic corner button behavior on award rows
- Both use `LINK_CORNER_OPTIONS` configuration

---

### **4. Routes Definition**

**File:** `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\routes\web.php`

**Careers Routes:**
- `GET /careers` → renders `pages.careers.index` (list view)
- `GET /careers/view/{no}` → renders `pages.careers.view` (detail view)

**Award Routes:**
- `GET /inside/award` → renders `pages.inside.award` (award list)

---

### **Key Observations for Responsive Design Planning:**

1. **Careers List:** Already responsive with filter bar and list—just ensure dropdowns stack on mobile (`@include mq(sm)`)
2. **Careers Detail:** 2-column grid converts to single column at `md` breakpoint—consider if map/sidebar needs further mobile tweaks
3. **Award Page:** **CRITICAL GAP** — No mobile breakpoints defined. The 4-column grid will not adapt to smaller screens. Recommend adding:
   - `@include mq(md)` for 2-column layout
   - `@include mq(sm)` for single-column layout
   - Consider hiding year/award columns on mobile, or use collapsible rows
4. **Hover Preview:** Award preview uses `position: fixed` with `fluid()` width—works but may need positioning adjustments for mobile
5. **Filter Bar:** Already has `@include mq(lg)` but may need `@include mq(md)` or `@include mq(sm)` for tighter screens
